status: complete bounded static optical diagnostics; no parity verdict
scope: Static REST and settled center-HELD optical differences for four backgrounds x two themes. No dynamics, frame pacing or general native parity verdict.
registration: None. Native world origin is observed window(0,0); Android uses the report's actual background source screen origin and density. Android is sampled once onto the native2px/pt world grid. No thumb-bounds fitting, center realignment, per-scene registration, phase compensation, color normalization or contrast fitting between platforms.
raw_geometry: Retain the Android first uncalibrated REST geometry, target-minus-raw residual and the one bounded fixed fixture translation verbatim. The fixture's optical-only translation excludes this comparison from product geometry acceptance.
native_geometry_limit: This source72 staticOptics trace omits presentation-tree traversal. The31pt AX frame is the slider control, not an observed visual lens boundary. Fixed world diagnostic windows are not alpha masks; native oval silhouette and corner differences remain visible in unwarped raw crops.
phase: REST attachments precede DOWN. Native HELD is a real captured display bracketed by actual delivered DOWN/UP, starting0.65s+ after DOWN. Android HELD uses a declared controlled Compose clock settled1600ms before capture and a real active DOWN. These are stable state comparisons, not equivalent natural-time samples.
source_dependence: Compare source baselines independently in the same world crop. Pattern phase/rasterization differences remain visible and are not absorbed into a material fit. Native background-input lacks overlaid title/rail; Android baseline is the plain composited source, so observed residual includes any refracted foreground roles not removed by conservative masks.
rail_exclusion: All material diagnostic windows exclude world |y-430|<=8pt, including selected rail and conservative halo. The whole raw crop is retained for visual review but receives no aggregate material score.
title_exclusion: Native SwiftUI title actual bounds are x20..118,y382.5..402pt. A conservative upper-left influence area x<123,y<430 is excluded from material windows. This is a declared source-dependent exclusion, not proof of finite blur/refraction support; foreground source influence may extend farther.
metric_limits: Luminance/background slope and contrast ratios are apparent image diagnostics, not physical transmission/opacity. Channel-gradient spread is a dispersion-sensitive proxy confounded by background color, refraction, highlights and rasterization; it cannot identify a physical dispersion coefficient.
acceptance: No similarity pass threshold and no tuning from this report. Capture-validity checks and source/geometry provenance are separate from the observed optical differences.
